CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linked to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates, organization/presentation (coordinate listing) and separate origin/status fields are explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to an identified content's organization or access.

C.rationale: Literal assignments enumerate identified content (colored cell sets) with attributes (red/blue).

D.rationale: Origin/status fields are provided separately from the content coordinate listings, distinguishing identification from status.

O.rationale: Coordinate lists explicitly present how the content is organized/presented (cell positions).
